patch.value: Migrate hand-written public/sw.js and public/cookie-consent.js to TypeScript sources

Migrate the hand-written public/sw.js service worker and public/cookie-consent.js classic script to TypeScript sources only, with deterministic build outputs emitted at the same public URLs (/sw.js, /cookie-consent.js). Add ServiceWorker + DOM typings with no any/ts-ignore, remove hand-written JS source status (make them generated build artifacts), retain the generated JS at the public URLs for runtime packaging, integrate with build/typecheck/watch/release/pack scripts, update tests to validate source and generated behavior, keep HTML behavior unchanged. Do not touch HTML/CSS source, hosted data, telemetry, Caddy, secrets, or legal text.

public/sw.js and public/cookie-consent.js are generated from TypeScript sources (no hand-written JS source); output is valid JS (no TS type annotations) served at the same public URLs /sw.js and /cookie-consent.js; ServiceWorker and DOM typings are added with zero any/@ts-ignore; npm run typecheck, npm run build, npm test, npm run audit:prod, npm run pack:dry-run, and npm run changelog:check all pass; tests validate source typing and generated output behavior; HTML/CSS source, hosted data, telemetry, Caddy, secrets, and legal text are untouched

value.text: Resolution & evidence (2026-07-13): PROBLEM: npm run release:check failed at audit:prod with EALLOWSCRIPTS (--allow-scripts not allowed in project-scoped installs) because ~/.npmrc sets allow-scripts and the bare `npm audit --omit=dev` inherited the restricted environment. The partial migration also introduced `npx tsc` in typecheck:frontend/build:frontend, which can trigger npx network resolution even though local tsc exists. FIX (package.json only; no HTML/CSS/legal/hosted/telemetry/secrets touched): (1) audit:prod changed from `npm audit --omit=dev` to `env -u npm_config_allow_scripts npm audit --omit=dev --ignore-scripts` (matches established pattern in pm-csv/pm-github/pm-linear; unsets npm_config_allow_scripts so npm does not reject the restricted environment, --ignore-scripts keeps audit non-mutating). (2) typecheck:frontend/build:frontend replaced all `npx tsc` with bare `tsc` (npm adds node_modules/.bin to PATH; local typescript@7.0.2 resolves with no npx/network fallback) and extended to compile the three frontend projects (main + tsconfig.sw.json + tsconfig.scripts.json). VERIFICATION (all green): git diff check shows only .gitignore/package.json/public/tsconfig.json changed plus pre-existing .agents/pm files preserved; untracked TS sources + tsconfigs + test. npm run typecheck PASS. npm run build PASS. npm test 74 pass 0 fail (incl 4 new static-scripts tests). Direct audit: env -u npm_config_allow_scripts npm audit --omit=dev --ignore-scripts found 0 vulnerabilities exit 0. Scripted audit: npm run audit:prod found 0 vulnerabilities exit 0 (EALLOWSCRIPTS resolved). npm run pack:dry-run PASS (207 files; public/sw.js 12.4kB + public/cookie-consent.js 2.1kB packed for runtime serving). npm run changelog:check: Changelog up to date exit 0. npm run release:check (full gate) exit 0. Generated outputs public/sw.js + public/cookie-consent.js are valid plain JS (new Function parses), serve exactly at /sw.js and /cookie-consent.js, and are git-ignored (.gitignore lines 15-16); public/src/sw.ts and public/src/cookie-consent.ts are tracked (NOT ignored). ACTUAL RESULT: all acceptance criteria met.

patch.value: TypeScript static-runtime migration complete and release:check green. Fixed the release:check EALLOWSCRIPTS failure by making audit:prod environment-neutral (env -u npm_config_allow_scripts npm audit --omit=dev --ignore-scripts, matching the established pm-csv/pm-github/pm-linear pattern) and removed npx network resolution from typecheck:frontend/build:frontend by using bare local tsc (node_modules/.bin resolved via npm PATH; local typescript@7.0.2). public/sw.js and public/cookie-consent.js are now generated build artifacts from public/src/sw.ts and public/src/cookie-consent.ts (WebWorker/DOM libs, zero any/ts-ignore), served at the same public URLs, git-ignored, and packed for runtime serving; TS sources are tracked. Verification: npm run typecheck PASS, npm run build PASS, npm test 74/74 pass (incl 4 new static-scripts tests), direct + scripted audit:prod found 0 vulnerabilities exit 0 (EALLOWSCRIPTS resolved), npm run pack:dry-run PASS (207 files, sw.js 12.4kB + cookie-consent.js 2.1kB packed), npm run changelog:check up-to-date exit 0, npm run release:check full gate exit 0. All 3 linked pm tests passed. No HTML/CSS/legal/hosted/telemetry/secrets modified.
